name: Neelanon
description: Neelanon was a planet located in the Neelanon system in the Senex sector of the Mid Rim Territories, in grid square L-17 of the Standard Galactic Grid. It was the homeworld of the human senator Terr Taneel, who represented the Senex sector in the Galactic Senate of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
